name: breakage-calendar-mcp
description: Which dated upstream breaks (image tags that move, AI models and APIs that shut down, CI runners that retire) hit your repository or dependency list, and the tested fix.
long_description: Reads the public Breakage Calendar from cybernative.ai and runs each date's own published search over a dependency list, file contents, or a project folder you allow. Each finding says whether it hits or may hit, what changes, who is affected, how to check, and the fix; for a tested fix, the day we ran it. Nothing from your project is sent anywhere: the server makes two GET requests for the public calendar files.
